Balance sheet leverage is high (total liabilities 11,824M vs. total assets 12,240M; equity only 415M), which reduces loss-absorbing capacity; although liquidity appears adequate (current ratio ≈ 1.78), the combination of negative earnings and thin equity supports a speculative, highly stressed rating.

DECISION: CCC-
